name: Missouri
overview: A refundable Property Tax Credit covers qualifying seniors, disabled people and certain surviving spouses who own or rent.

programs.name: Property Tax Credit
programs.ageRule: Age 65+, 100% disabled, service-connected 100% disabled veteran, or age 60+ receiving qualifying surviving-spouse benefits.
programs.incomeDefinition: Missouri adjusted income plus specified nontaxable Social Security, pension, assistance and other income; statutory exemptions and offsets apply.
programs.incomeLimits: Renters/part-year owners: $27,200 single or $29,200 combined; full-year owner-occupiers: $30,000 single or $34,000 combined.
programs.formulaSummary: Apply the MO-PTC chart to program net income and eligible property tax or 20% of qualifying rent; caps and owner/renter income offsets differ.
programs.application: MO-PTS with MO-1040 if an income return is required; otherwise standalone MO-PTC.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year Missouri residence is required for the ordinary age-65 route.
Rental property must pay real-estate tax.
Claim only qualifying principal-residence taxes; fees and excess acreage are excluded.
interactions: County-option senior property-tax freeze relief is a separate local program.

researchNotes: The chart, not a simple maximum-credit comparison, determines the payable amount.
The 2025 MO-CRP instructions confirm the 20% rent conversion after qualifying rent reductions.
